scripts.start: node api.js && concurrently "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend"
scripts.start-backend: node api.js && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.start-frontend: node api.js && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build-frontend: node api.js && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build-backend: node api.js && echo "No build step for backend"
